Overview.Name: Vijayalakshmi Vakapalli
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Do not skip meals. Even a simple meal is better than skipping.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Keep meals ready in advance to avoid missing meals due to work.
Maintain consistent meal timing to support thyroid health.
Regular meals will improve energy, mood and fat loss.
